description: This file is a shell script used for testing the bitmap functionality in Git. It contains multiple test cases that execute Git commands to verify behaviors such as bitmap creation, corruption handling, delta reuse, boundary traversal, and lookup table writing within the context of Git's repacking and packing processes.

methods.name: objpath
methods.description: A function to construct the object path in the .git directory based on a SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: list_packed_objects
methods.description: Lists objects present in a pack file associated with the given index file.

methods.name: has_any
methods.description: Tests whether the content-file has any entries from the pattern-file.

methods.name: test_bitmap_cases
methods.description: Main function executing a series of test cases related to Git bitmap functionalities, including creation, corruption, reuse, boundary traversal, and lookup table writing.
